channel.title: theSVG Blog
channel.description: Announcements, releases, and updates from theSVG - the open SVG brand library

item.title: theAuth joins GLINR Studios: open-source auth for AI agents, now with Go
item.description: theAuth, the open-source auth for AI agents and humans, has joined GLINR Studios, with a new site at theauth.dev, a Go library, and a hosted platform on the way.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (GLINR Studios)

item.title: Browse Icons by Recently Added or Popular
item.description: theSVG now has dedicated Recently Added and Popular pages across all 7,400+ icons, plus a homepage switch that remembers which view you prefer.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: 10 SVG Icon Performance Hacks Every Frontend Developer Should Know
item.description: Beyond 'use SVG instead of PNG': ten small, measurable tricks for icon-heavy pages, from content-visibility and mask-image recoloring to debounced search and real dark-mode variants.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: A More Alive Icon Page: Brand Colors, Completeness, and Smoother Motion
item.description: Every icon page now picks up an ambient wash of the brand's own color, shows a plain-language completeness checklist instead of a vague score, and reacts to your scroll and theme instead of sitting still.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: 12 draw.io / diagrams.net Shape Libraries Are Live
item.description: Download 12 category-based shape libraries for draw.io and diagrams.net, covering brand and dev-tool logos the built-in AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes libraries do not include.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: AWS vs Azure vs GCP Icons: Which Cloud Icon Set Should You Use?
item.description: AWS, Azure, and GCP each ship their own icon set with a different visual language. Here is how they differ, and how to get all three in one consistent format for diagrams that mix providers.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: theSVG for React Native and Expo
item.description: All 6,500+ icons now ship for React Native and Expo via @thesvg/react-native, backed by react-native-svg. Same typed, tree-shakeable story as the web package, no config plugin needed.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: 6,500+ Icons: What Shipped Since GLINR Studios
item.description: Two months after crossing 6,115 icons, theSVG passed 6,500. Kubernetes icons landed, a new community collection grew to 256 logos, and categories quietly passed 140.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: Building a Dark-Mode-Safe Logo Wall: Variants, Contrast, and the Details Most Integration Pages Skip
item.description: Invisible logos, blurry marks, and mismatched styles are the three ways a customer or integration logo row breaks. Here is how to fix all three with variant selection alone.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: Give Your AI Coding Agent Brand Icons: A theSVG MCP Server Walkthrough
item.description: Stop letting your AI agent guess at CDN URLs for brand logos. Set up the @thesvg/mcp-server package in five minutes and get live, always-current icon lookups in Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-aware client.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: theSVG is Joining GLINR Studios
item.description: Big news: thesvg.org is becoming part of GLINR Studios, a new umbrella we are building for our products. The library stays open source. Here is what this means for you.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (GLINR Studios)

item.title: The Largest Open SVG Brand Library of 2026: 6,115 Icons in Three Months
item.description: From a March 2026 launch to over 6,000 brand SVGs by June. How theSVG became the largest open brand SVG library of 2026, what we shipped, and what is next.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: Google 2026 Icons Are Live: 13 New Gradient Logos in SVG
item.description: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Docs, Sheets, Slides and 6 more: the Google 2026 gradient refresh, packaged as free SVG downloads for developers.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: The theSVG Figma Plugin is Live
item.description: Browse 6,030+ brand SVGs without leaving Figma. Variant picker, recents row, keyboard shortcuts, dark mode aware.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: theSVG is Now on Raycast
item.description: Search and copy any of our 5,600 icons directly from Raycast. No browser needed.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: Azure and Google Cloud Icons Join theSVG
item.description: 626 Microsoft Azure service icons and 214 Google Cloud Platform icons are now available. theSVG is now the largest free cloud icon library.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: 5,600+ Icons: Building the Definitive SVG Icon Hub
item.description: From brand logos to cloud architecture diagrams, theSVG now covers every icon a developer needs. Here is our vision for what comes next.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: 739 Official AWS Architecture Icons Now Available
item.description: Every AWS service, resource, and category icon from the official 2026-Q1 icon set. Lambda, EC2, S3, and 736 more.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)

item.title: Introducing theSVG: The Open SVG Brand Library
item.description: We launched theSVG with 4,000+ brand SVG icons. Free, open-source, and community-driven. Here is why we built it and what is next.
item.author: team@thesvg.org (theSVG Team)
